refresh.schedule: Regenerate with python scripts/generate_proof_json.py and deploy the docs/ snapshot on GitHub Pages.
refresh.note: The page loads this snapshot file. If a later refresh fails or HOJO is down, the last committed snapshot remains on GitHub Pages. A 6-hour GitHub Action is staged at scripts/github-workflows/proof-refresh.yml pending a token with the workflow scope.

honesty.house_note: House payments are self-funded test and catalog-refresh payments by the operator. They are not third-party customers.
honesty.operator_identity_note: The published XRPL merchant identity account is listed separately. It is not a house test buyer and is not counted as an external payer.
honesty.sku_mapping_note: sku_id is inferred when a settled amount uniquely matches a live catalog price, or taken from a prior annotated snapshot. Ambiguous or unknown amounts stay unlabeled.
honesty.probe_note: Automated directory/probe calls are real settled external payments from known recurring probes (for example Lumi paying 0.001 XRP for /t54/hello daily). They are listed separately and are not counted as customers.
honesty.dust_note: Unsolicited or dust transfers are incoming payments whose amount does not uniquely match a live SKU price (for example 1-drop or 10-drop XRPL transfers). They are excluded from the external SKU-purchase headline.
honesty.unverified: This page only reports on-chain payments to the published payTo addresses and the health of public HTTPS endpoints. No unverified volume or customer claims.
